_note: SIMPLIFIED FOR EDUCATION — capacities are educational approximations, not real user guides. Sources noted per launcher.

launchers.name: Electron (class)
launchers.description: Small launcher for CubeSats. Cheap but tiny fairing.
launchers.descriptionAr: صاروخ صغير للأقمار المكعبة. رخيص لكن سعته محدودة.
launchers.source: Rocket Lab Electron user's guide ~300 kg to LEO (simplified).

launchers.name: Vega-C (class)
launchers.source: Arianespace Vega-C manual ~2.3 t to LEO (simplified).

launchers.name: Falcon 9 (class)
launchers.description: Workhorse medium-heavy launcher. Best cost per kg.
launchers.descriptionAr: صاروخ العمل الأساسي. أفضل تكلفة لكل كيلوغرام.
launchers.source: SpaceX Falcon 9 manual ~17-22 t to LEO, midpoint 17.5 t (simplified).

launchers.name: Ariane 6 (64, class)
launchers.description: Heavy launcher for comsats and lunar missions.
launchers.descriptionAr: صاروخ ثقيل لأقمار الاتصالات والمهام القمرية.
launchers.source: Arianespace Ariane 6 manual ~20 t to LEO for 64 config (simplified).

launchers.name: Falcon Heavy (class)
launchers.descriptionAr: صاروخ فائق الثقل لمهام المشتري وأوروبا المباشرة.
launchers.source: SpaceX Falcon Heavy ~60 t to LEO (simplified, expendable proxy).

launchers.name: Super Heavy (class)
launchers.description: 100 t class for Saturn-scale direct missions. Lowest reliability, biggest jaw.
launchers.descriptionAr: فئة 100 طن لمهام زحل المباشرة. موثوقية أقل لكن قدرة أضخم.
launchers.source: Super-heavy lift ~100 t to LEO class proxy (simplified).
